# NYC Taxi — Airport Trips

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Analysis of airport trips (rate codes 2, 3)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    rate_code_id,
    z.zone as pickup_zone,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(trip_distance) as avg_distance,
    AVG(total_amount) as avg_fare,
    AVG(tip_amount) as avg_tip
FROM trips t
LEFT JOIN taxi_zones z ON t.pickup_location_id = z.location_id
WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2019-02-27'
  AND t.pickup_datetime < '2019-05-28'
  AND t.rate_code_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY rate_code_id, z.zone
ORDER BY trip_count DESC
LIMIT 20
```
